findings.title: Model router uses cloud/external model aliases not present in local Ollama available models list

evidence.observation: Routing policy configures 'gemini-flash-latest' across 7 task types and 'nomic-embed-text' (vs 'nomic-embed-text:latest') which are not local Ollama models
Ollama available models list does not include gemini-flash-latest, relying on upstream API routing or cloud fallback without explicit local fallback mapping

proposed_action.description: Verify external cloud API credentials and document fallback local models for gemini-flash-latest routed tasks (e.g. gemma4:12b or qwen3.5:9b)

findings.expected_benefit: Clarifies provider boundaries and ensures resilient fallbacks when cloud endpoints encounter rate limits or outages
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: model_catalogue_drift; Evidence strength: None; Confidence: 0.85; Risk: low; Automation: needs_more_evidence; Reason: Evidence insufficient (need strong)
